title: Circadian transcriptional pathway atlas highlights a proteasome switch in intermittent fasting
body:
##  [ Circadian transcriptional pathway atlas highlights a proteasome switch in intermittent fasting ](</content/reactome-research-spotlight/186-reactome-pathway-gene-sets-in-the-msigdb-facilitated-identification-of-the-liver-proteasome-transcriptional-switch-that-acts-as-the-fasting-timer-in-intermittent-fasting>)

Reactome pathway gene sets in the MSigDB facilitated identification of the liver proteasome transcriptional switch that acts as the fasting timer in intermittent fasting in work published by [Wei et al. in Cell Reports on October 25, 2022](<https://www.cell.com/cell-reports/fulltext/S2211-1247\(22\)01403-6?_returnURL=https%3A%2F%2Flinkinghub.elsevier.com%2Fretrieve%2Fpii%2FS2211124722014036%3Fshowall%3Dtrue>). The authors suggest that a 16-hour interval in intermittent fasting may be most beneficial for health.
